body: From the DM-185 review (orchestrator, this run): fix and pin — (1) latent two-hop import refusal: importer checks the hash over raw file content but stores default-filled content and the exporter fills defaults, so a run.json lacking `followUps` imports on B, then B's re-export is refused on C (importer.ts:344 with :1059) — hash and store the same normalized form; (2) delivery_gap maps confirmed_failure only to code_defect while the ticket finding withholds as multiple_candidate_causes, and it carries a vacuous `P.score at_least 0` guardrail (retroFindings.ts:341); (3) an even 50/50 split is flagged as corrective concentration (retroFindings.ts:300; require a strict majority); (4) coverage.items does not match its doc for delivery_gap (:405) and coordination_problem (:218). A legacy report with no scorecard, edited and re-hashed, is accepted on a fresh machine (pre-existing).
